articles.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% from last year, but topped Street forecasts
articles.snippet: Crypto trading volume fell 38% from year-ago levels, but the firm's overall blockchain business gained traction.

articles.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
articles.snippet: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.

articles.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
articles.snippet: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

articles.title: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
articles.snippet: The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.

articles.title: A $3M Hedge, a Midterm Test and Retail's Rise: Prediction Markets at NEXTPredict
articles.snippet: Chuck Todd called markets a "fact checker" for journalism, as Kalshi, Polymarket and Robinhood pitched contracts well beyond elections.
